product_family: AI meeting notetaker and transcript enrichment platform for teams

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Grain is SOC 2 Type II certified. SOC 2 Type II audit ensures that we conform to the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) SOC 2 standard. We have received a clean Type II report implying that our customers' meeting data is properly managed, protected, and secured.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 audited GDPR compliant [homepage trust badges, shown together under 'Top teams use Grain to power their AI']

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Grain holding ISO 27001. The security page notes that AWS (Grain's cloud host) provides ISO 27001 assurance ('Amazon provides an extensive list of compliance and regulatory assurances, including SOC 1-3, and ISO 27001'), but this is the host's certification, not Grain's.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: A support article states 'Grain complies with industry regulations and standards, such as GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC 2, where applicable' but no BAA, HIPAA-specific controls, or explicit HIPAA compliance documentation was found. The qualifier 'where applicable' is a material hedge. No mention of HIPAA on grain.com/security or trust.grain.com resources list.

privacy.ai_training_note: Grain explicitly states 'Neither Grain nor its subprocessors use your data for model training.' OpenAI (a named subprocessor) does not train on API data per their API policy ('OpenAI does not use data submitted to and generated by our API to train OpenAI models or improve OpenAI service offering'). However, AI features cannot currently be disabled in Grain. OpenAI retains API data for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring before permanent deletion. The opt-out applies at an API level via OpenAI policy, not as a per-user toggle in Grain.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: SSL/TLS enforced on all connections; A+ grade on Qualys/SSL Labs; HTTP automatically redirected to HTTPS

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: All customer data including call recordings and transcripts encrypted at rest on AWS (PostgreSQL on EBS, object storage on S3)

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: 100% of primary application servers in Grain's own AWS Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) in the USA, protected by restricted security groups; deployments managed via Terraform with pre-deployment review

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration testing; results document available via trust center request

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Unique production database authentication enforced; encryption key access restricted; unique account authentication enforced; only engineers with operational need have production access

security.name: Authentication options
security.value: Google, Microsoft, or SSO supported across tiers; SAML available for Enterprise customers

security.name: Application security
security.value: Built with Elixir/Erlang and Phoenix framework following OWASP guidelines; mandatory code reviews for all changes; security review for new features

security.name: Cybersecurity insurance
security.value: Cybersecurity insurance maintained (listed as a security control in trust center)

security.name: Disaster recovery
security.value: Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established and tested (listed as trust center controls)

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Users can delete individual meetings, entire sets of recordings, or workspace data from within Grain; customer data deleted upon leaving per trust center controls

products.name: Enterprise
products.category: AI meeting notetaker with enterprise security controls
products.data_scope: Unlimited meetings; full feature set with enterprise security
products.notes: SAML SSO; custom pricing; all seats must be on Enterprise plan; DPA likely available on request but not published; contact sales

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with per-seat monthly or annual subscriptions; free plan available with 20 meeting cap
compare.data_residency: USA only (AWS); no EU or other regional data residency options publicly advertised

flags: HIPAA claim qualified as 'where applicable' in a support article with no BAA evidence; do not treat as HIPAA-compliant without requesting a BAA directly from Grain.
No public DPA found despite GDPR compliance claim; EU-based teams must request DPA before deploying and should clarify the GDPR data transfer mechanism (SCCs) used for US-hosted data.
Data stored in USA only; no EU data residency option, which creates GDPR Chapter V transfer risk without confirmed SCCs.
AI features cannot currently be disabled per Grain support docs, limiting granular user control over AI subprocessor data flows.
OpenAI retains API data for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring before deletion; users should be aware their meeting content transits OpenAI infrastructure.
ISO 27001 referenced on grain.com/security belongs to AWS (the cloud host), not Grain itself; Grain does not hold ISO 27001.
No tier-specific data isolation confirmed; Enterprise tier adds SAML SSO but no documented data segregation beyond account-level access controls.
